anasayfa.baslik: Kazuist: find the legal source, see what supports it
anasayfa.aciklama: Legislation, court decisions, authority decisions and articles in one search. Every summary sentence shows its source beside it.
anasayfa.giris: We bring legislation, court decisions, independent authority decisions and legal articles into one search. Every sentence of the short summary sits next to the source it rests on; without a source, the sentence is not written.
anasayfa.aramaIpucu: Example: rent increase rate, limitation period in tort, explicit consent under KVKK
anasayfa.orneklerBaslik: You can start with these questions

ornekler.1: How is the rent increase rate for housing determined?
ornekler.2: Limitation period for compensation claims arising from tort
ornekler.3: When is explicit consent required under KVKK?

anasayfa.serhBaslik: Every sentence is read with its source
anasayfa.serhGiris: Margin note layout: the sentence on the left, its source level with it in the right margin. On a phone the sources move below the sentence.
anasayfa.serhOrnekNotu: Layout example. The text and citations are placeholders, not a real summary.
anasayfa.serhOrnek1: The first sentence of the summary sits here and only reports what appears in the source beside it.
anasayfa.serhOrnek2: The second sentence rests on another source; its authority class is shown with shape and text.
anasayfa.modullerBaslik: From research to writing in one place

modul.ara: Search a question or topic; the source list, short summary and decision network come together.
modul.yazma: Get a Word template that follows your institute's guide or a journal's rules, and track your writing goal.
modul.pratik: Revise topics with card games and HMGS decks.
modul.rehberler: Article and thesis guides, Zotero and EndNote walkthroughs, a pre-submission checklist.

anasayfa.kampusMetin: A feed where researchers share their work, abstracts and posters. Reading and following are free.

fiyatlar.aciklama: Kazuist plans, credit packs and credits per operation. Prices include VAT.
fiyatlar.giris: Search, filters, labels and viewing the citation network are free. Operations that use AI run on a daily free allowance, your own key (BYOK) or credits.

kural.2: Promotional credits are valid for 90 days; they are not refunded or converted to cash.
kural.3: No credit is charged when no summary is produced for lack of sources or because of a technical error.
kural.4: Operations above 20 credits ask for your confirmation first.
